header.title: Sessions
header.subtitle: Open longer session notes in a larger editor for easier reading and writing.

newForm.title: New Session Record
newForm.subtitle: Write your longer notes comfortably on an enlarged text screen.

list.title: Saved Sessions
list.subtitle: Open any session to view its full notes.

empty.title: No session records yet
empty.hint: You can create the first record using the "+ Add Session" button.

editForm.title: Edit Session
editForm.subtitle: You can edit long fields on a wide screen with “Expand”.

toast.emptyForm: Please fill in at least one field.
toast.addFailed: Session record could not be added.
toast.emptyUpdate: An empty session cannot be updated.
toast.updateFailed: Session record could not be updated.
toast.deleteFailed: Session record could not be deleted.
toast.invalidDuration: Session duration must be a whole number between 0 and {max} minutes.
toast.recordConflict: This record was changed in another tab or device. Your change was not saved; the latest version was loaded — review it and save again.

error.loadFailed: Session records could not be loaded

conflict.title: This record was changed in another tab or device
conflict.description: Your text is kept; nothing has been saved yet. Only the differing fields are shown below. Choose which value to keep for each field (the latest record is preselected), then press “Save selections”.

h05.copyFailed: Could not copy — select the text and copy it manually

deleted.title: This record was deleted on another device
deleted.message: Your draft is kept and can be copied. The deleted record will not be recreated; if you wish, create a new record yourself through the normal add flow.

h05.noChange: No difference remains between your selections and the latest record; the record was not changed.

leave.title: Unsaved changes
leave.message: You have unsaved edits in the Client Journey. If you leave the page, your text will be lost.
leave.linkGone: The link is no longer on screen; you stayed on the page. Please click the link again.
